svg.title: Red, White and Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study. Approximate geometry; interpretive colours. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red, blue, white; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://whitney.org/collection/works/58; reviewed 2026-10-26; not a facsimile.
